capabilities: Render diffs from pasted git patch text in fenced code blocks
Generate diffs from a local Git repository by branch, tag, commit or revision range
Restrict generated diffs to specific file paths
Configure diff layout, theme, fonts and highlighting via block frontmatter or plugin settings
disambiguation: Not a version-control or note-history tool; it only renders code diffs, running git read-only and never writing to a repository.
extras: Flagged as shell execution because repo blocks invoke the local git executable; the README documents exactly which read-only git subcommands run and states there are no network requests or telemetry. Repository-diff blocks are Desktop-only and do not work on mobile or in browsers.
problem: Obsidian shows pasted patch text as plain code with no diff rendering, and cannot display changes from a local Git repository inside a note.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses @pierre/diffs as the (beautiful) rendering engine.

summary: Renders code diffs inside notes as code-diff code blocks, either from pasted git patches or generated from a local Git repository.
